newsitem.title: JAPAN: Tokyo stocks lower in early morning trade.
newsitem.headline: Tokyo stocks lower in early morning trade.

text.p: Tokyo stocks were lower in early morning trade on Tuesday, with sentiment still feeble after the recent sell-off, brokers said.
They said that the bottom of the index was vulnerable and that it might test a further downside.
At 0017 GMT, the Nikkei 225 average was down 104.81 points or 0.53 percent at 19,585.65. Its March futures were 10 points lower at 19,580.
The market was closed on Monday for a national holiday.
